label: l29-abort-proof
_why: The live proof owed by TESTBED_LANDMINES L29 / L19: run_schedule.ps1 aborts the whole schedule after two consecutive instant failures (an observer that exits non-zero under 90 s never got the game running). A stand-in process named victoria3.exe (ping.exe copied, the L19 proof's stand-in) is started AFTER the scheduler's preflight gate has passed, so every observer refuses beside it, as it would beside a game orphaned mid-batch. The user, 2026-10-28: 'Go on now.'

_arms.control: {kind: control} - vanilla + telemetry; chosen so that, if the refusal somehow did not fire, the run would be a vanilla game that quits at 1836.3.1

_predictions.run 1: the observer refuses ('Victoria 3 is already running (PID ...)'), exits non-zero in seconds; the scheduler logs an ALERT naming L19/L29
_predictions.run 2: the same; the scheduler logs a second ALERT and 'TWO CONSECUTIVE INSTANT FAILURES ... Aborting the whole schedule'
_predictions.run 3: never started; no game launched at any point

_cost: 3 builds of the control arm at most and no game time; a few minutes
